Snezhnaya Live Symphony Performance | Genshin Impact #GenshinImpact #NowSnezhnaya #GenshinSnezhnaya
Conducted by Robert Ziegler, the Snezhnaya Live Symphony Performance features pianist Polina Osetinskaya @polinaosetinskaya127 , the London Symphony Orchestra, London Voices choir, and top folk musicians performing two game soundtrack pieces produced by HOYO-MiX, "Snezhnaya" and "Triumph on the Ice."

A big thank you to TAKEOFF Studios for providing collaboration support, and to Stagecast for their support with filming and production.
========
‌
Snezhnaya
Composers: Peijia You (HOYO-MiX) / Yu-Peng Chen / Deer Suo (HOYO-MiX) / Caroline Luo (HOYO-MiX) / Yang Li (HOYO-MiX)

Composer: Yang Li (HOYO-MiX)
